synopsis.text: Why is everyone rioting to oust Namor from the Avengers? Moonstone has the answer - and it's all part of an even greater plot!

The Avengers return from battling Immortus, as a large crowd of protesters has gathered outside of Avenger's Mansion in response to Namor's joining of the team. Meanwhile Moonstone has escaped prison, arriving at the Avenger's Mansion in an effort to rally the crowd into a riot, as Cap and Wasp calm the crowd she downs a helicopter which Namor manages to save. As the Avenger's recapture Moonstone, Namor saves the crew of the downed helicopter.

Following the battle, Namor is given a summons to be sued for 2 billion dollars, as he decides to face his accusers in court. However, shortly after he gets word Attuma has captured Marina, holding her in a trap for Namor which he heads to face him alone.
The cover is a homage of the cover of All-Star Comics #6.
